extracted.intended_audience: general readers and fans of cartoons/humour; cartoonists and editors interested in The New Yorker style
extracted.subtask_description: A short blog pointer to Bob Mankoff's TED Talk about how New Yorker cartoons are constructed and selected; aimed at readers curious about the magazine's 'idea drawings' and humour theory. Not a how-to or formal guideline, but a commentary/curation post.
